notes: 02: only title+favicon are fetched; no description or preview image collected. 03: title is editable before/after save but description is never collected, so no description to edit. 04: url/title/tags/note editable but there is no description field. 07: card shows title/favicon/tags/note but no description field exists. 10: TagInput is free-text with no autocomplete/suggestions from existing tags. 12: full-text search covers title/url/note (and tags) but there is no description field to search. 14: no #tag search syntax; a '#x' query is matched literally and does not resolve to a tag. 15: no AND/OR/NOT operators or parenthesised groups; query is a plain substring match. 16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. 17-19: no unread/read-later flag anywhere in schema or code. 20: no multi-select or bulk actions. 21: no bulk action scoped to current filter. 23: note is stored/saved but rendered as plain text, not as markdown. 24-25: no snapshot (local HTML/PDF or Internet Archive) feature. 26-28: no archive flag, no archive/delete distinction, no archived-only view. 29: no bundle/saved-filter entity. 30-31: no Netscape HTML import or export. 32: no personal display settings (default sort/items/font size) persisted.
